name: 19460 · Phoenixville, PA
findings: ZIP 19460 (Phoenixville) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19460 (Phoenixville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19460 (Phoenixville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 84 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
